text:
Ravi: Heads-up 10am sync today 15 mins: we need final copy + calc behaviour for the pricing page experiment. Focus areas: FAQ microcopy, tier names, calculator default view, and webinar gating.

Claire: Quick take on names: keep them benefit-oriented. Suggest: Pay-as-you-go / Predictable / Dedicated. Less flashy, more self-explanatory.

Diego: Agree. Also we should change the benchmark card to show a sample workload (chat assistant, 5k tokens/day) with estimated cost per month per tier. Helps people map to their use-case.

Faye: Calculator UX thought 3: make default view the "monthly spend" but show a toggle to "per-call". Also allow a small "advanced" row for concurrency and latency assumptions.

Noor: For FAQs I've drafted short bullets: 1) "How are tokens counted?" -> brief + link. 2) "Can I upgrade mid-month?" -> yes, prorating. 3) "Is my data private?" -> mention Dedicated/Private and retention. 4) "What support is included?" -> email + priority for Predictable/Dedicated. 5) "How do I estimate costs?" -> point to calculator. 6) "Are there volume discounts?" -> contact sales. I'll paste full copy after this thread.

Tom: Webinar gating: proposal: sign-up creates lead with field "pricing_signal" = slider_value. If slider >= 2000 => tag as "high-intent"; route to SDR. We'll also add a hidden question: "Are you evaluating for a product or platform?" to help prioritize.

Ravi: Good. A/B idea: Variant A shows the tier names + short blurb; Variant B shows the same but adds a microcase study under each tier (1-2 lines). We'll track conversion and demo requests.

Claire: Microcopy suggestion for calculator label: change "Estimated monthly" to "Estimated monthly spend (USD)" and add a tiny "based on your inputs" sublabel.

Diego: Data note: use price_per_1k = $0.06 for Pay-as-you-go row in mockups, $0.04 for Predictable, $0.025 for Dedicated (example numbers). Also show latency expectations in ms.

Faye: UX devs: please expose experiment flag `pricing_calc_variant` and `pricing_tier_labels_v2`. We'll need to QA both.

DeployBot: Experiment flags created: pricing_calc_variant, pricing_tier_labels_v2.

Noor: FAQ tone: keep it concise and product-led. Avoid legalese. E.g., "Yes, you can bring your own model via Dedicated/Private" instead of longer sentence.

Tom: Routing logic I'll implement in SFDC flow: if email_domain not in common_personal_providers AND pricing_signal >= 2000 -> assign to SDR queue X, else nurture path. Sending sample rules to #sales-inbound.

Ravi: Timeline: copy freeze by EOD tomorrow, front-end implements flags Wed, QA Thurs, soft launch Fri. Can everyone confirm blockers?

Claire: No blockers. I'll finalize 3 headline options and post by 3pm.

Diego: I'll create the benchmark images and attach them to the mock by 5pm.

Faye: I'll coordinate with Eng on the toggle and advanced row.

Noor: Will post FAQs doc in this channel after 2pm.

Tom: I'll drop the SFDC flow export for review before end of day.

Ravi: Thanks team  let's keep updates short in this thread. If anything comes up DM me. :sparkles:
